remarks: Located on a quiet cul-de-sac in desirable East Norwalk, this first-floor apartment offers a flexible 2-3 bedroom layout and an exceptional location close to the shoreline. The dining room can easily serve as a third bedroom, home office, or additional living space. Enjoy being just steps from Veteran's Park and a short walk to Calf Pasture Beach, the East Norwalk Train Station, SONO, restaurants, pubs, and the Maritime Aquarium. Laundry is available in the basement. A great opportunity to enjoy the convenience and lifestyle that East Norwalk has to offer.
